pokedexEntries.rb: A POKéMON that consists entirely of programming code. Capable of moving freely in cyberspace.

pokedexEntries.ye: The only POKéMON people anticipate can fly into space. None has managed the feat yet, however.

pokedexEntries.go: It is a manmade POKéMON. Since it doesn’t breathe, people are eager to try it in any environment.

pokedexEntries.rs: PORYGON is capable of reverting itself entirely back to program data and entering cyberspace. This POKéMON is copy-protected so it cannot be duplicated by copying.

pokedexEntries.la: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.
